title: Neurosift (v2)

author.name: flatironinstitute
author.field: Neurophysiology / systems neuroscience (extracellular ephys, single units, two-photon imaging, behaviour), using NWB fil

notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). A browser viewer that searches the DANDI Archive and also lists OpenNeuro datasets (an EMBER Archive browser link was seen but not opened). It opens an NWB file straight from cloud storage without downloading it and shows its metadata, object tree, spike rasters, PSTHs, imaging summary images and ROI masks, with Python snippets that load the same data. Opening a local file or a file by URL was not tried in this run. Data used in the run: public. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
